privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.desc: How Arthur Labs apps (Norte, Cuadre Préstamos and Clavuno) handle your data: what you save stays on your device. No accounts, no cookies, no analytics and no ads.
privacy.intro: Written in plain language. It explains what data exists when you use our apps, where it is stored and what we receive if you buy a Pro version.

sections.html:
• What you enter in our apps is stored only on your device. Arthur Labs does not receive it and cannot see it.
  • There are no user accounts or passwords, and we never ask you to connect your bank.
  • We use no cookies, analytics, ads or trackers, and the apps do not send your data to third parties.
  • If you buy Pro, Hotmart shares your name, your email and the status of your purchase with us. Never your card details.
  • We do not sell personal data.

sections.h: Who is responsible for this policy
sections.html:
Arthur Labs is a trade name registered in the Dominican Republic, based in Santo Domingo. Its owner is the data controller for the data described here. In this text, “we” means Arthur Labs.

This policy applies to the arthurlabs.app site and to our apps: {app:norte|Norte} (personal finance), {app:cuadre|Cuadre Préstamos} (loans, installments and collections) and {app:clavuno|Clavuno} (quotes, invoices and payments). Norte also has its own {app:norteprivacy|privacy policy}, with the same rules explained for that app.

sections.h: The data you save in the apps
sections.html:
Everything you enter in an app is saved in the browser storage of your own device. For example:

  • Norte: income, expenses, budgets, goals, debts, savings circles and personal loans.
  • Cuadre Préstamos: loans, installments, payments and receipts, plus the client details you choose to enter: name, phone, national ID number, address, reference or guarantor, and notes.
  • Clavuno: your business details and logo, your catalog, quotes, invoices and payments, plus your clients’ details: name, tax ID, phone, email and address.

Your preferences, such as language, currency and theme, are saved too.

That data is not sent to Arthur Labs. We don’t have a copy, we can’t see it and we can’t recover it for you.

Keeping it safe depends on your device: anyone who can unlock it and open your browser can see what you saved. We recommend using a screen lock and, in Cuadre, the app’s PIN.

In Cuadre and Clavuno you can save data about other people: your clients and, in Cuadre, also the person you enter as a reference or guarantor. That data stays on your device and we don’t receive it.

You decide what data you save and how you use it. Enter only what you need, have a legitimate reason to keep it, use it only for your business, and follow the data protection laws of your country.

• PDFs and receipts. They are created on your device, without being sent to any server.
  • Sharing. When you send a receipt, a quote or a reminder through WhatsApp or another app, the message goes out through that app and is governed by its own terms.
  • Notifications. Clavuno’s reminders are generated by your device. They only appear if you allow them, and you can turn them off at any time.
  • Voice. If you dictate a transaction in Norte, speech recognition is done by your device or your browser’s provider (for example, Google or Apple), not by Arthur Labs.

sections.h: What we receive when you buy Pro
sections.html:
Purchases are made through Hotmart, which charges and processes the payment. From Hotmart we receive:

  • your name,
  • your email address,
  • the product you bought and the status of the purchase (for example, approved or refunded).

We never receive your card or payment details.

We use that data to send you your activation key, answer your questions and handle refunds. We do this because it is necessary to fulfill the purchase you made and our legal obligations. We keep it while you hold the license and for as long as tax and accounting laws require. We don’t sell it or use it for advertising.

What Hotmart does with your data is governed by Hotmart’s privacy policy.
The Pro key is checked inside the app, on your device. Activating it sends no data to Arthur Labs or to third parties.

We use no cookies, analytics tools, ads or trackers. The apps make no requests to third-party services: fonts and all other files are served from our own domain.

The site stores a single preference in your browser, the language you chose, to show you pages in that language. It is not a cookie and it is not sent to any server.

The site and the apps are hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc.). As with any website, that service may log technical connection data, such as the IP address and the date, in order to operate and protect itself. We do not use those logs to identify you or to track what you do.

If you write to us at {email}, we use your address and your message only to reply and resolve your question, because we have a legitimate interest in helping you. We keep the conversation for up to two years after your last message, so we can follow up if you write again.

Each app lets you download a backup file and restore it later, on the same device or another one. That file contains your data: keep it somewhere safe and treat it as a private document.

In Cuadre and Clavuno, the backup does not include your license key: if you switch devices, enter it again. In Norte, the backup does include the key and activates Pro when you restore it, so don’t share that file with anyone.

Making backups is your responsibility. If you clear your browser data, uninstall the app or lose your device without a backup, your data is lost and we can’t recover it.

The data in the apps is in your hands: you can view, correct, export and delete it whenever you want, from the app itself or by clearing your browser data.

For your purchase data and your messages, you can ask us for access to them, to correct them or delete them once they are no longer needed, for a copy in a commonly used format, and you can object to a specific use. We respect the rights given to you by the data protection laws that apply to you, such as Law 172-13 of the Dominican Republic, the GDPR if you live in the European Union, or the LGPD if you live in Brazil. To exercise them, write to us at {email} from the email address you used to buy. You can also file a complaint with the data protection authority in your country.
Hotmart, GitHub and our email provider may process data in countries other than yours, with their own safeguards. We only use these services for what this policy describes.
Our apps are tools for adults and businesses. They are not intended for anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect data from minors.
If this policy changes, we will publish the new version here with its date. If an app ever adds a feature that sends data off your device, we will explain it on this page before it becomes available.
This policy is available in Spanish, English, French and Portuguese. If there is any difference between versions, the Spanish version prevails.
Arthur Labs · Santo Domingo, Dominican Republic · {email}

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.desc: Terms of use for Arthur Labs apps (Norte, Cuadre Préstamos and Clavuno): plans, one-time Pro license, responsible use and limits of liability.
terms.intro: These terms explain how you can use our apps and what your purchase includes. By using an app or buying Pro, you accept them.

sections.html: These terms apply to the arthurlabs.app site and to the Arthur Labs apps: {app:norte|Norte}, {app:cuadre|Cuadre Préstamos} and {app:clavuno|Clavuno}. Arthur Labs is a trade name registered in the Dominican Republic. Norte also has its own {app:norteterms|terms}; where they are more specific to Norte, they prevail.

Free. You can use each app without paying and without giving a card. The free plan has the limits shown inside the app.

Pro. It is a one-time payment, not a subscription: there are no recurring charges. The price is the one shown in the app and on Hotmart at the time of purchase. Your Pro license for that version of the app has no expiration date and includes the updates we publish for that version.

Trial. Norte lets you try Pro free for 14 days inside the app, with no card. When the trial ends you stay on the free plan and nothing is charged.

Purchases are made through Hotmart, which processes the payment and issues the purchase receipt under its own terms.

After you buy, you receive your activation key by email, at the address you gave when buying, within 24 hours. To activate it, open the app, go to Pro, paste the key into the “License key” field and tap “Activate” (in Norte: Settings → Plans → Activate license). You can also enter it on your other devices.

The Cuadre Préstamos purchase also includes the Excel system, which you download from Hotmart.

When you buy Pro you get a personal license to use the Pro version of that app:

  • It is for one person and their own devices.
  • It is not transferable: you can’t assign it or pass it on to someone else.
  • You can’t resell it, rent it, or share or publish your key.

The apps, the Excel files, their design, their code and the Arthur Labs, Norte, Cuadre and Clavuno brands belong to Arthur Labs. The license lets you use them; it doesn’t give you the right to copy, modify, resell or redistribute them. If you use the license against these conditions, your right to use Pro ends.

Use the apps lawfully and honestly. You may not:

  • use them to deceive, defraud, harass or threaten other people;
  • collect debts through abusive methods or lend money on terms that the law of your country prohibits;
  • try to get around the license system or distribute keys;
  • copy or modify the apps’ code to sell or publish it.

What you save in the apps stays on your device. Making and keeping backups is your responsibility. If you clear your browser data, uninstall the app or lose your device without a backup, your data is lost and we cannot recover it. The {link:privacy|privacy policy} explains this in detail.

If you save data about your clients, you are responsible for handling it lawfully.

• Norte is an educational tool for organizing your money. It is not financial, tax, legal or investment advice, and its simulators are illustrative.
  • Cuadre Préstamos calculates installments, interest and late fees with the data and rules you set up. It is not legal or financial advice and it does not replace a contract. You are responsible for making sure your loans and collections comply with the laws of your country, including maximum interest rates.
  • Clavuno creates quotes, invoices and receipts for your business with the taxes you set up. These documents do not replace the tax receipts required by your country’s tax authority (for example, the NCF or e-CF of the DGII in the Dominican Republic).

Always check calculations and documents before you use them. For important decisions, consult a professional.

Every Pro purchase has a 15-day guarantee. When a purchase is refunded, the license stops being valid and you lose the right to use Pro; you can keep using the free plan. The details are in the {link:refunds|refund policy}.

We work to make the apps run well, but they are provided “as is.” We don’t guarantee that they are error-free or that they work on every device and browser.

We may improve, change or remove features. The Pro features you bought for that version remain included in your license.

To the extent permitted by law, Arthur Labs is not liable for indirect damages, for loss of data or for financial losses or decisions resulting from the use of the apps. In any case, our total liability to you is limited to the amount you paid for the license of the app concerned.

Nothing above limits the rights the law grants you as a consumer that cannot be excluded.
We may update these terms. We will publish the new version here with its date. If you keep using the apps after a change, you accept the new version.

These terms are governed by the laws of the Dominican Republic. Any dispute will be submitted to the competent courts of the Dominican Republic, without prejudice to the non-waivable rights granted to you by the law of your place of residence.
These terms are available in Spanish, English, French and Portuguese. If there is any difference between versions, the Spanish version prevails.
For any question about your purchase, your key or these terms, write to us at {email}.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.desc: 15-day guarantee on every Arthur Labs purchase (Norte Pro, Cuadre Préstamos and Clavuno Pro): how to request your refund and what happens to your license.
refunds.intro: If an app isn’t right for you, we give you your money back. It’s that simple.

sections.html: All our purchases have a 15-day guarantee from the date of purchase: Norte Pro, Cuadre Préstamos (app and Excel system) and Clavuno Pro. Within that period you can request a full refund without having to explain why.

1. Through Hotmart: sign in to your Hotmart account with the email you used to buy, open the purchase and use the option to request a refund.
  2. Or write to us: send an email to {email} with the email you used to buy and the transaction code (it starts with HP). We will handle it for you.
Hotmart returns the money to the same payment method you used. How long it takes to show up depends on your payment method and your bank; with a card it can take one or two statements to appear.

When a purchase is refunded, the corresponding Pro license stops being valid and you lose the right to use Pro. You can keep using the free plan, and your data is not deleted: it stays on your device.

If your purchase included files (such as Cuadre’s Excel system), you no longer have a license to use them and you must delete your copies.

After the guarantee period we don’t issue refunds. If there was a duplicate charge or a billing error, write to us at {email} and we’ll review it with Hotmart.

None of this limits the rights your country’s law gives you as a consumer.
Write to us at {email}. You can also see the {link:terms|terms of use} and the {link:support|support} page.

support.title: Support
support.desc: Help with Norte, Cuadre Préstamos and Clavuno: installation, Pro key, backups and refunds. Write to us at hola@arthurlabs.app.
support.intro: Need help with an app, your key or your purchase? Write to us. A person will reply, not a bot.
support.contactBody: We usually reply within 1 to 3 business days, in Spanish, English, French or Portuguese.
support.mailSubject: Help with an Arthur Labs app

sections.html:
In your email, tell us:

  • which app you use and on which device and browser (for example, Android with Chrome or iPhone with Safari);
  • what happened and what you expected to happen, with a screenshot if you can;
  • if it is about your purchase, the email you used to buy and the transaction code (it starts with HP).

Never send us passwords, card details or your backup file. We will never ask you for them.

faq.q: How do I install the app on my phone?
faq.a:
Android (Chrome): open the app’s link, tap the ⋮ menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.

iPhone (Safari): open the link, tap the Share button and choose “Add to Home Screen”.

Computer (Chrome or Edge): click the install icon in the address bar.

faq.q: Do I need internet to use it?
faq.a: Only the first time you open it. After that it works offline, because everything is saved on your device.

faq.q: I bought Pro. Where is my key?
faq.a: It arrives at the email address you gave when buying, within 24 hours. Also check your spam and promotions folders. If you can’t find it, write to us from the email you used to buy.
Open the app and go to Pro. Paste your key into the “License key” field and tap “Activate”. In Norte it’s under Settings → Plans → Activate license. Repeat this on your other devices.

faq.q: Is my data stored in the cloud?
faq.a: No. It is stored only on your device and we cannot see it. That is why it is important to download backups.

faq.q: How do I move my data to another phone?
faq.a: In the old app, go to Settings and download the backup. Send that file to yourself (by email or WhatsApp). On the new phone, open the app, go to Settings and restore the backup. In Cuadre and Clavuno, enter your Pro key again; in Norte it activates by itself with the backup.

faq.q: How do I request a refund?
faq.a: You have a 15-day guarantee. You can request it from your Hotmart account or by writing to us. The details are in the {link:refunds|refund policy}.

faq.q: I lost my key or changed my email.
faq.a: Write to us with the name and email you used to buy and the transaction code, and we will help you recover it.
